bio: Experienced software developer with 5 years of commercial and business development experience building server-based and cloud-based applications using Node.js (Node.js + Express.js, SAP CAP with Node.js, SAPUI5, SAP BTP cloud solutions, microservices, and external system integrations)

Well-versed in CI/CD principles with hands-on experience in configuring automated pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins

Comfortable working in product teams and taking ownership of system components independently
